author: Xyla Foxlin
description:
Ok, so whilst this project mostly turned out great, it did take a little longer than a weekend, and there's a few things I would change if I was to do this again.

Firstly, the door is kind of a pain to get in and out where it is. If you plan on making this, maybe move the door to one of the side walls and install it forward of the wheels instead. This could also save you money on a window - you could get away with a door on one side and a window on the other, or even a window on the back).

Secondly, I’d spend more time trying to find a trailer that isn't the Harbor Freight one, the axle is just really annoyingly far forward.

And lastly, my first revision of this design had plywood cabinets in the front two feet of the interior. This would be a convenient place to store your clothes, etc while camping. I nixed them because of the $1000 constraint, but if you're willing to spend an extra $100 on plywood it would absolutely be worth it.

Has anyone else made their own camper!?

title: My DIY Camper Build
